scripts.build: node -e "const f=require('fs'),a='.github/workflows/update.yml';if(f.existsSync(a)&&f.readFileSync(a,'utf8')!==f.readFileSync('src/pages/update-workflow.yml','utf8')){console.error('src/pages/update-workflow.yml must match '+a);process.exit(1)}" && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

PASSWORD.description: The password to sign in to your site builder, 12 characters or more.

DB.description: Where your site, its versions and your contact messages are kept.

IMAGES.description: Where the photos on your site are kept.
